content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Albany

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Verify your education and work history meet these thresholds before enrolling. Granite PM Academy's advisors can review your background and clarify any questions about qualifying experience.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. You'll attend instructor-led sessions online, covering the PMBOK Guide framework and real-world case studies. The bootcamp is structured to fit working professionals' schedules while preparing you for exam content and rigor.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, complete your official PMI application, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application portal and can answer questions about required documentation and submission steps.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—study guides, practice tests, and Q&A support—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE when you feel ready. On exam day, you'll answer 180 multiple-choice questions in a proctored environment, either online or at a test center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll earn the PMP designation for a three-year cycle. During that period, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by attending training, speaking, publishing, or leading project-management activities. Before your renewal date, submit your PDUs to PMI and pay the renewal fee to keep your credential active.
